meaning.en: A book so popular that everyone copies it and paper grows scarce.
meaning.zh: 形容著作广受欢迎，流传很广。

examples.zh: 这部小说一出版就洛阳纸贵。
examples.en: The novel became a runaway bestseller as soon as it came out.

examples.zh: 她的新书洛阳纸贵，一再加印。
examples.en: Her new book is selling like hot cakes and keeps being reprinted.

story.en: Zuo Si's 'Rhapsody on the Three Capitals' was so admired that people in Luoyang copied it until paper became expensive.
story.zh: 《晋书》：左思《三都赋》成，“豪贵之家竞相传写，洛阳为之纸贵”。

usage.zh: 作谓语，称赞作品。

meaning.en: The mixed feelings only someone who has been through it can know.
meaning.zh: 其中的甘苦，只有亲身经历的人才能体会。

equivalents: only those who've been through it know

examples.zh: 创业的个中滋味，只有自己知道。
examples.en: Only you know what starting a business is really like.

examples.zh: 离乡多年，个中滋味难以言说。
examples.en: After years away from home, it is hard to say how it feels.

usage.en: Object; often 个中滋味，冷暖自知.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“个中滋味，冷暖自知”。

meaning.en: Arrogant and ignorant of how big the world is.
meaning.zh: 比喻无知而狂妄自大。

equivalents: a big fish in a small pond

examples.zh: 别夜郎自大，外面的世界很大。
examples.en: Don't be so insular and arrogant; the world is big.

examples.zh: 取得一点成绩就夜郎自大，可不行。
examples.en: Getting conceited over a small achievement won't do.

story.en: The ruler of the small state of Yelang asked a Han envoy whether Han or Yelang was bigger, ignorant of Han's vastness.
story.zh: 《史记》：“滇王与汉使者言曰：‘汉孰与我大？’及夜郎侯亦然。以道不通故，各自以为一州主，不知汉广大。”

usage.zh: 作谓语，含贬义。

natural: with nose and eyes all there

meaning.en: Described in such convincing detail that it sounds true.
meaning.zh: 形容说得具体生动，像真的一样。

examples.zh: 他把这件事说得有鼻子有眼的。
examples.en: He told it in such convincing detail.

examples.zh: 传闻有鼻子有眼，大家都信了。
examples.en: The rumour was so detailed that everyone believed it.

usage.zh: 作补语，口语，常指传言。

meaning.en: Quick, fluent and sharp in speech.
meaning.zh: 形容口齿灵活，能说会道。

examples.zh: 这孩子伶牙俐齿，很会说话。
examples.en: This child has a quick tongue and speaks well.

examples.zh: 她伶牙俐齿，谁也辩不过她。
examples.en: She's so quick-tongued nobody can out-argue her.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; positive or teasing.
usage.zh: 作谓语、定语，褒义或戏谑。

meaning.en: It turned out exactly as expected.
meaning.zh: 事情的结果和预料的一样。

examples.zh: 我早料到他会来，果然如此。
examples.en: I knew he'd come, and so it proved.

examples.zh: 事实果然如此，没有出人意料。
examples.en: It was exactly so; no surprises.

usage.zh: 作谓语或独立成句。

meaning.en: One's native place is hard to leave behind.
meaning.zh: 对故乡充满眷恋，不愿离开。

examples.zh: 故土难离，老人不愿搬到城里。
examples.en: Attached to his homeland, the old man won't move to the city.

examples.zh: 虽然外面机会多，但他故土难离。
examples.en: Though there are more chances elsewhere, he can't bear to leave home.

usage.zh: 作谓语或独立成句。

natural: as if walking on level ground

meaning.en: To move or do something with complete ease, even where it is hard.
meaning.zh: 像走在平地上一样，形容毫无困难。

examples.zh: 攀岩高手在峭壁上如履平地。
examples.en: The expert climber moves up the cliff as if on level ground.

examples.zh: 他对这条山路很熟，走起来如履平地。
examples.en: He knows the mountain path so well that he walks it with ease.

usage.zh: 作谓语、补语。

meaning.en: Sarcastic, unkind remarks.
meaning.zh: 带有讽刺意味的、不友善的话。

examples.zh: 面对旁人的冷言冷语，她没有放弃。
examples.en: Facing others' snide remarks, she did not give up.

examples.zh: 别对朋友冷言冷语的。
examples.en: Don't make cutting remarks to your friends.

usage.zh: 作宾语，含贬义。

literal: hundred · birds · pay court to · phoenix
natural: a hundred birds paying homage to the phoenix

meaning.en: A virtuous or great figure drawing everyone's allegiance; also a celebrated suona piece.
meaning.zh: 传说凤凰是百鸟之王，比喻有德者受众人拥戴，也是著名的唢呐曲。

equivalents: all pay homage to a great figure

examples.zh: 新领导一上任，便呈百鸟朝凤之势。
examples.en: As soon as the new leader took office, everyone rallied round.

examples.zh: 民乐《百鸟朝凤》用唢呐模仿鸟鸣。
examples.en: The folk piece 'A Hundred Birds Pay Homage to the Phoenix' imitates birdsong with the suona.

usage.en: Noun or allusion; also a painting subject.
usage.zh: 作名词或典故，也是常见的绘画题材。

meaning.en: Irregularly interlocking, like a dog's teeth, as in borders or terrain.
meaning.zh: 形容交界处像狗牙一样参差不齐地交错。

examples.zh: 两省边界犬牙交错，管理困难。
examples.en: The border between the two provinces interlocks irregularly and is hard to administer.

examples.zh: 海岸线犬牙交错，形成许多小海湾。
examples.en: The coast is jagged, forming many small bays.

usage.zh: 作谓语，多形容边界、海岸、战线。

meaning.en: Achieving more, faster, better and more economically; a slogan for efficient construction.
meaning.zh: 指数量多、速度快、质量好、成本省，是建设中的口号。

examples.zh: 工地提倡多快好省地完成任务。
examples.en: The site promotes finishing tasks more, faster, better and cheaper.

examples.zh: 这套方案实现了多快好省。
examples.en: This scheme achieved more, faster, better and cheaper results.

usage.zh: 口号式用语，带有上世纪五十年代色彩。

meaning.en: In such a precarious state that one cannot be sure of lasting until evening.
meaning.zh: 早晨保不住晚上，形容形势危急，难以维持。

examples.zh: 战乱年代，百姓朝不保夕。
examples.en: In the years of war, ordinary people lived in daily peril.

examples.zh: 公司资金断裂，朝不保夕。
examples.en: The company's cash has run out and it's hanging by a thread.

usage.zh: 作谓语，较正式。

meaning.en: The great river flows eastward; the opening of Su Shi's ci on Red Cliff, evoking time passing and heroes fading.
meaning.zh: 苏轼词开篇名句，写长江东流不返，抒发历史和人生的感慨。

examples.zh: “大江东去，浪淘尽，千古风流人物。”
examples.en: 'The great river flows east, its waves washing away all the heroes of the ages.'

examples.zh: 读到大江东去，不禁感慨历史的沧桑。
examples.en: Reading 'the great river flows east', I couldn't help reflecting on history's vicissitudes.

story.en: Su Shi, gazing at the Red Cliff, opens with the Yangtze flowing east and washing away the heroes of every age.
story.zh: 苏轼《念奴娇·赤壁怀古》：“大江东去，浪淘尽，千古风流人物。”

usage.en: Quoted line; also a fixed image for fleeting time.
usage.zh: 多作引用，也是表现时光流逝的意象。

meaning.en: The seven daily household necessities: firewood, rice, oil, salt, soy sauce, vinegar and tea.
meaning.zh: 指柴、米、油、盐、酱、醋、茶，泛指日常生活必需品。

examples.zh: 开门七件事，样样都要钱。
examples.en: Every one of life's seven daily necessities costs money.

examples.zh: 她每天都在为开门七件事忙碌。
examples.en: She is busy every day with the daily household necessities.

usage.en: Noun; the full phrase continues 柴米油盐酱醋茶.
usage.zh: 作名词，下接“柴米油盐酱醋茶”。

natural: mention one and miss ten thousand

meaning.en: To list or discuss only a little and leave out a great deal; also a modest apology for incompleteness.
meaning.zh: 只提到一点，遗漏很多，常用作自谦说法。

examples.zh: 以上介绍难免挂一漏万，请多指正。
examples.en: The above is bound to leave much out; please point out any errors.

examples.zh: 短短一篇文章，只能挂一漏万。
examples.en: In so short an article I can only touch on a fraction.

usage.zh: 作谓语，谦辞。

natural: the dove takes the magpie's nest

meaning.en: To seize someone else's home or property.
meaning.zh: 斑鸠强占喜鹊的窝，比喻强占别人的房屋、土地或地位。

examples.zh: 他们鸠占鹊巢，赖在我家不走。
examples.en: They've seized my home and won't leave.

examples.zh: 原管理层被架空，等于鸠占鹊巢。
examples.en: The old management was sidelined, which amounts to usurpation.

story.en: The Book of Songs says: the magpie has a nest, and the dove lives in it (维鹊有巢，维鸠居之).

date.zh: 西周初至春秋中叶 · 前11—前6世纪
date.en: early Western Zhou to mid Spring and Autumn, 11th–6th c. BC

usage.zh: 作谓语，含贬义。

meaning.en: Human determination can overcome nature.
meaning.zh: 人力能够战胜自然。

equivalents: where there's a will there's a way

examples.zh: 人定胜天，我们一定能战胜洪水。
examples.en: Man can conquer nature, and we will defeat the flood.

examples.zh: 他们治沙造林，真是人定胜天。
examples.en: Taming the desert and planting forests, they really show that people can master nature.

usage.en: Stand-alone saying; sometimes questioned from an ecological view.
usage.zh: 可独立成句，现在也有人从生态角度反思。

meaning.en: A rich, fertile region with plentiful fish and grain.
meaning.zh: 物产丰富的地方，尤指水产和稻米丰富的地区。

examples.zh: 江南自古是鱼米之乡。
examples.en: Jiangnan has been a land of fish and rice since ancient times.

examples.zh: 这个鱼米之乡风景如画。
examples.en: This land of plenty is as pretty as a picture.

usage.zh: 作名词。

meaning.en: Stretching on continuously without interruption.
meaning.zh: 连续不断地延伸。

examples.zh: 群山绵延不断，一眼望不到头。
examples.en: The mountains stretch on unbroken as far as the eye can see.

examples.zh: 绵延不断的车流堵满了高速公路。
examples.en: A continuous line of traffic jammed the motorway.

usage.zh: 作定语、谓语。

natural: turn back and find the shore

meaning.en: It is never too late to turn from wrongdoing; usually 苦海无边，回头是岸.
meaning.zh: 只要悔改，就有出路；常说“苦海无边，回头是岸”。

equivalents: it's never too late to mend

examples.zh: 苦海无边，回头是岸，他决定自首。
examples.en: The sea of suffering is boundless, but turning back brings the shore; he decided to give himself up.

examples.zh: 警方劝他回头是岸，早日投案。
examples.en: The police urged him to turn back from crime and surrender.

usage.zh: 可独立成句，源自佛教用语。

meaning.en: Spending one's time on food, drink and pleasure.
meaning.zh: 吃饭、喝酒、玩耍、享乐，形容只图享乐不做正事。

examples.zh: 他整天只知道吃喝玩乐。
examples.en: All he does all day is eat, drink and have fun.

examples.zh: 周末的安排就是吃喝玩乐。
examples.en: The weekend plan is just food, drink and fun.

usage.en: Predicate or object; mild disapproval or teasing.
usage.zh: 作谓语、宾语，略带批评或调侃。

natural: commit crimes and break the law

meaning.en: To do evil and break the law.
meaning.zh: 为非作歹，触犯法律。

examples.zh: 对作奸犯科之徒，必须依法严惩。
examples.en: Those who commit crimes must be severely punished according to law.

examples.zh: 他从不作奸犯科，是个守法的人。
examples.en: He has never broken the law and is a law-abiding man.

story.en: Zhuge Liang advises: if there are those who do evil and break the law, or those who are loyal and good, hand them to the officials to judge (若有作奸犯科及为忠善者，宜付有司论其刑赏).
story.zh: 《出师表》：“若有作奸犯科及为忠善者，宜付有司论其刑赏。”

usage.en: Predicate or attributive 之徒; formal.
usage.zh: 作谓语，或作“之徒”的定语，较正式。

natural: remain faithful to one until the end

meaning.en: To stay with one partner for life, once traditionally demanded of widows; also to stay loyal to one cause.
meaning.zh: 旧指女子一生只嫁一人；也泛指对一个人或一件事始终不变。

equivalents: remain faithful to one for life

examples.zh: 他对事业从一而终，从未换过行。
examples.en: He has stayed faithful to his career and never changed fields.

examples.zh: 古人讲究从一而终，现在观念已变。
examples.en: The ancients stressed lifelong fidelity to one partner, but attitudes have changed.

usage.en: Predicate; the traditional sense is now often criticised.
usage.zh: 作谓语，旧义现多受批评。
